description: Integrate the ocms (Octopus Metrics Summary) library into any PyTorch training script to report training metrics (loss, learning rate, timing, eval scores, grad norm, etc.) to the Huawei Octopus platform for visualization. Use this skill when the user mentions ocms, Octopus metrics, training metric reporting/upload/visualization, or wants to add metric logging to a training script. Supports custom training loops, HuggingFace Trainer, PyTorch Lightning, Accelerate, MMEngine, and shared base classes. Also triggers when the user asks to report/upload/log training metrics and the ocms package is installed in the conda env.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent gather relevant evidence before concluding?
Did the final report trace conclusions back to observable evidence?
